resources.string: Start Pip when the phone starts
Starts Pip after you unlock your phone following a restart.
Automatic start needs “Display over other apps” permission.

Lets Pip work other apps when you ask him to — open one, tap, type, scroll, go back — and see when a keyboard is on screen so he can keep out of its way. He reads the labels of the screen in front only while doing a job you asked for, never a password field, and nothing he reads is kept or sent anywhere except as a list of labels to the AI model you chose.
